name: One Way Guesthouse Busan
detail: The location is right next to Busan Station, with the train station and bus station just outside. There are many shops and restaurants across the street, making travel and dining very convenient. Most importantly, the prices are very affordable, but the environment is great and clean. The bedroom and bathroom are tidy and not dirty at all, overall exceeding my expectations. I stayed here for three days and only spent *** RMB. Although it was a four-person room, the last two days I had it to myself, meaning I enjoyed a single room for just *** yuan a day. The staff is very friendly and can communicate in both Chinese and English, and they are welcoming to foreigners. Highly recommended!

name: Haeundae Marine Capsule Hotel and Spa
detail: Location: A 5-minute walk from Haeundae Station Exit 7 Facilities: Bedding and amenities are all clean! Staff are super friendly 👍 The spa sauna is small but really helps relieve fatigue! The self check-in and check-out are easy :) If you're looking for a cost-effective capsule hotel, I recommend it~~!

name: Signiel Busan
detail: My first trip to Busan. I chose to stay by the sea. The room has a great view of the ocean, which is fantastic. The lounge had champagne, and I had a good time. The Sky Capsule station was also nearby and very convenient. I want to stay here again.

name: NOMADX Stay Hostel
detail: This time I chose a single room, and there are a lot of compartments in the room for placing items. Each room has an independent password lock, so even if you go out, the power won't cut off. The capsule dormitory also has individual doors with password locks for each compartment, and I feel that the soundproofing won't be too bad. There are about six restrooms and six shower rooms for females, all very clean. I also didn't encounter any waiting situations. The common lounge area is very spacious; you can choose to work alone here or meet some friends from other places. A simple breakfast in a European and American style is provided from 8 to 10 in the morning, including bread slices, cereal, and coffee. The staff here comes from all over the world, and many are traveling while working. They are always willing to help. Overall, it was a very satisfying accommodation experience, and if I travel to Busan alone again next time, I would still consider staying here!

name: Dynamic Guesthouse
detail: I urgently found this accommodation due to a workshop, but it was really cost-effective and clean. The host was kind, and I appreciated that fresh towels were provided every morning. I regretted not being able to enjoy it leisurely since it wasn't for travel, but I would like to stay here for travel purposes next time :)

name: Goodday CUBE Seomyeon Capsule Hotel
detail: I hurriedly found this place and checked in alone, and I was really pleasantly surprised! The hotel itself seemed newly built, and everything was extremely clean and well-maintained. The bedding was dry and the pillows were Sealy. The shower room and shared spaces were also clean, and honestly, I didn't have high expectations for the room since it was small, but I slept so well that it felt cozier than expected. (It felt like coming out of hibernation in a cave…) The location was good, making public transportation convenient, and the staff was friendly. I think this is a great place for solo travelers to stay comfortably and lightly. The value for money was also satisfying, so I would be willing to use it again next time. I enjoyed the bread you baked for breakfast.

name: Mini Hotel May Nampo
detail: The hotel is about a 5-minute walk from Exit 1 of Nampo Station or about a 1-minute walk from Exit 13 of the underground mall. I chose a room with a window that overlooks Busan Tower, and the view from the 13th floor is so beautiful that I don't even want to go outside. The room size is moderate, and the bathroom is separate, with the bathtub not having a partition from the room. The hotel corridors and facilities are a bit old but overall clean. The only downsides are that the sound insulation isn't great and there are some sounds from the water pipes or wind at night (the front desk offers free earplugs). I also think the price is very affordable.

name: ASTI Hotel Busan Station
detail: It was my first trip to Busan, so I struggled until the very end to decide which area would be the best for accommodation. In the end, since it was a family trip including high school boys, I prioritized convenience over style and chose the Asti Hotel, which turned out to be a great decision!! ● Being adjacent to Busan Station made traveling to any destination really easy. ● Since we had a Mar Suite, the room was spacious, allowing three of us to relax comfortably. ● The toilet and bath were separate, and there were two sinks, which was really nice. ● The bathtub was large and spacious, allowing for a leisurely soak. ● The staff at the front desk spoke a little Japanese, and handling our luggage after check-out was perfect. ● There were two bottles of water daily. No toothbrushes. Paper cups were provided. There were phone ports. I brought my own SE-type curling iron. Slippers were available. A few downsides: ● The hotel lacked any stylishness and was more business-oriented. However, the spacious Mar Suite made up for it. The men were very satisfied. ● The doors were excessively hard to open and close and were a bit shaky. ● One of the desk drawers was broken and left as is. ● There was a slight sewer smell. However, I think this is common in foreign countries. Overall, for my first time in Busan, the hotel near the station was convenient for accessing places like Haeundae and Nampo-dong. It also had a Starbucks on the first floor and a convenience store nearby, so I can recommend it!! There was also a coin laundry, which was convenient!! I think it’s a very good hotel, as long as you’re not looking for style.

name: Ramada Encore by Wyndham Busan Station
detail: I have stayed in Busan several times for travel, but this time I chose based on location. I imagined it would be a bit more modern and newer, but that wasn’t the case. However, it was spacious enough, and the security was solid, so I could stay comfortably. There was no bathtub, just a shower, and the amenities were standard; one should not have excessive expectations, but given the location in front of the station, I was very satisfied with the accommodation in this price range.

name: JH Blossom Capsule and Cabin Hotel
detail: 在市中心核心区，紧邻着商业街，地铁步行八分。似乎晚上会有很多人在街边。 里面一切都非常干净，装修的非常现代。 公区在地下一层，设施齐全。楼层也有公区沙发、充电、贩卖机、洗手间、饮水机。但吃东西只能去地下。 早餐是烤面包片和饮料，有咖啡。 胶囊间宽敞安静，床垫舒适，小桌子、充电、灯光、通风设计的都很齐全。 淋浴间和卫生间设施齐全，非常干净，还有睡衣和毛巾提供。 门口有烘干鞋柜，唯一的不足是储物室太狭窄，基本上适合短途旅行带一点点行李的人，在这里开关大行李箱不太方便，也没有挂外套的挂衣架，我挂到了床边。 员工很友好，积极帮助我。
